title: Provenance-bearing typed evidence comparison for narrative bridge alternatives
independentExamples: A declared activation transition connects an inactive nonce device to a later signal state.
A declared travel event connects a nonce courier at an origin to a later observation at a destination.
inputTypes: typed before and after event frames
two or more opaque typed bridge alternatives
provenance-bearing causal temporal goal state contradiction and participant evidence
preconditions: Every support or attack is established by a validated semantic relation rather than candidate position.
The bridge is checked against both the preceding and following event.
The comparison margin and evidence-family weights are explicit.
invariants: Candidate order and evidence order do not affect the selected semantic alternative.
Full renaming preserves results when typed relations are preserved.
Removing or reversing an enabling relation changes support or yields UNKNOWN.
No lexical cue, candidate position, source identity, row identity, or expected answer participates in core control flow.
uncertaintySemantics: Missing evidence, exact ties, and margins below the declared threshold remain UNKNOWN and are not resolved by source order.
proofBehavior: Every result carries ranked contributions and a digest-bound comparison witness independently recomputed by the verifier.
resourceBounds: Two through 32 alternatives, at most 2,048 evidence records, bounded strengths and weights, and at most 64 frames per bridge derivation call.
kbMigration: None. The comparator remains unregistered and no automatically derived bridge evidence is promoted because the development control failed.
guardianReasons: Nonce/full-renaming, candidate and evidence permutation, semantic contrast, explicit tie, missing-evidence, provenance, resource, and witness-verification tests pass.
The comparison primitive is generic only because typed evidence is an explicit precondition; it does not infer commonsense relations from surface text.
The automatic frame-overlap integration answered 826 of 1,532 development cases but was correct on only 440, so it is not eligible for runtime registration or a benchmark capability claim.
A sound bridge selector still requires provenance-bearing causal, temporal, goal, state-transition, contradiction, and coreference relations from declarative providers.
